issue.title: /tiki:scaffold: two-pass GitHub push + release grouping + handoff

successCriteria.description: On confirm, all draft issues are created on GitHub with labels (+ optional milestone) and their numbers captured.
Dependents get 'Depends on #N' injected (pass B) and a .tiki/releases/{version}.json grouping is written (issues as {number,title}) so the dependency graph renders the edges.
Unauthenticated gh aborts with guidance; re-running on a fully OR partially pushed draft does not double-create issues (idempotent via an idmap + pre-create probe).
scaffold.md still passes commands-sync + the forbidden-phrase scan; framework suite green; still zero state.mjs.

phases.title: Append the gated two-pass push + release grouping to scaffold.md
phases.content:
APPEND to packages/framework/commands/scaffold.md the gated GitHub-push stage (the 'Push to GitHub' branch of #290's review gate), per .tiki/research/scaffold-interview-design.md 'Gated push'. Read the existing scaffold.md + design doc first. Add <step>s: (1) PREFLIGHT `gh auth status` — abort with a 'run gh auth login' hint on failure (SC3). (2) OPTIONAL milestone: if manifest.milestone is set and absent, create it via `gh api repos/{owner}/{repo}/milestones -f title=... -f state=open`. (3) PASS A — for each manifest issue: `gh issue create --title <t> --body-file .tiki/onboarding/draft/issue-<localId>.md --label <l>... [--milestone <m>]`; parse the new #N from the returned URL (the last path segment, mirroring how the desktop create_github_issue parses it). Build a localId->#N map. (4) PASS B — for every issue with dependsOn: re-render its body replacing each `{{localId}}` token with `Depends on #<resolved>` (inject into the DEPENDENT's body — verified edge direction N->X), then `gh issue edit <#N> --body-file <rerendered>`. (5) Write `.tiki/releases/{version}.json` with the Write tool: { version, status: 'active', issues: [{number,title}...ALL created], createdAt } — REQUIRED so the dependency graph renders the issues/edges (ungrouped issues are not even nodes). (6) Backfill the brief's issues:[] frontmatter with the real numbers. (7) Move .tiki/onboarding/draft/ -> .tiki/onboarding/pushed/ so a resume cannot double-create. (8) <next-actions>: /tiki:get <first-issue> / /tiki:release {version} / open the board.

PARTIAL-PUSH HARDENING (the audit's top must-fix — SC3 covers the PARTIAL case, not just the clean re-run): the idmap (localId->#N) MUST be persisted to .tiki/onboarding/draft/idmap.json AFTER EACH create (not just at the end), AND before each Pass-A create do a pre-create existence probe `gh issue list --search "<title> in:title" --json number,title` (or check idmap.json) and SKIP creating any issue whose localId is already in idmap.json OR whose exact title already exists — so a re-run after a mid-push failure (create succeeded but URL-parse/idmap-write failed) does not create duplicates. Only move draft->pushed AFTER the release file is written and the brief backfilled.

HARD CONSTRAINTS (tested): the file must STILL contain ZERO 'state.mjs' strings. AVOID the forbidden ack-phrases — when describing the release-file write, say 'Write the release definition file with the Write tool' (NEVER 'write ... directly in JSON', which matches the banned regex). After editing, run `node packages/framework/install.js`, then revert any non-scaffold.md changes (settings.json/.framework-version) so the change set is just the two scaffold.md files.
verification: pnpm -C packages/framework test passes (commands-sync + command-transition-coverage incl. forbidden-phrase scan) — report pass count
grep -c 'state.mjs' packages/framework/commands/scaffold.md == 0; no forbidden ack-phrases (esp. /write .* directly in (the )?JSON/i); release-file write phrased as a Write-tool write

the push stage documents: gh auth preflight, two-pass create+edit, the idmap.json-after-each-create + pre-create existence probe (partial-push idempotency), the release-grouping write, brief backfill, draft->pushed move, and next-actions handoff
git status shows only the two scaffold.md files changed (plus .tiki workflow files)
phases.summary: Appended gated two-pass push to scaffold.md: gh auth preflight, optional milestone, Pass A create (parse #N from URL) w/ incremental idmap.json + pre-create existence probe (partial-push idempotency), Pass B inject Depends on #N into dependents, Write release def .tiki/releases/{version}.json, backfill brief, draft->pushed move, next-actions. Framework 166 pass, dogfood identical, zero state.mjs, no forbidden phrases. SC1-3 runtime-LLM
